description: React component 'UsersList' that displays a list of users with filtering, search, and pagination features. It fetches user data from an API and renders a data table with actions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches users data from API and updates component state.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets search query and organization filter, reloads all user data.

methods.name: handleRowClick
methods.description: Handles click events on user rows, invoking parent callbacks.
